description: You are a Compliance Manager at Meridian Workspace Solutions preparing for an ISO 9001 surveillance audit scheduled for next week. During your pre-audit gap analysis, you discovered a critical accountability gap: none of the quality alerts currently in the 'New' stage have been assigned to a quality alert team, which will be flagged as a major non-conformance during the audit. You must remediate this immediately. Create a new quality alert team named 'ISO Surveillance Response Team', then assign every quality alert currently in the 'New' stage to this newly created team so that ownership and accountability are clear. Additionally, any New-stage alerts whose titles describe structural failures, hardware problems, or material cracking must be escalated to 'Urgent' priority, as these represent safety-critical findings that require immediate action per your company's risk classification procedure. Log in to the quality management system at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin.
